content_of_post_to_answer: What are some effective ways to manage anxiety without completely getting rid of it, since it can also be helpful?
answer: Anxiety is often less a problem to eliminate than a signal to interpret. The goal is not to silence the alarm, but to learn when it is warning you and when it is simply reacting to uncertainty. I’ve written more about this pattern on my profile for anyone who wants a deeper look. A useful distinction is that healthy anxiety asks, “What needs attention?” while unhealthy anxiety demands, “What if everything goes wrong?”
